"import csv
from docx import Document

CSV_PATH = "perf_01.csv"
OUT_PATH = "report.docx"
COLS = ["config", "cl_max", "cd_cruise", "ld_ratio"]

# ---------- Read the CSV, preserving original text for faithful table display ----------
with open(CSV_PATH, newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
    reader = csv.reader(f)
    header = next(reader)
    raw_rows = [[c.strip() for c in row] for row in reader if any(c.strip() for c in row)]

norm = {h.strip().lower(): i for i, h in enumerate(header)}
idx = {c: norm[c.lower()] for c in COLS}
records = [{c: row[idx[c]] for c in COLS} for row in raw_rows]
n = len(records)

# ---------- Compute statistics from the data ----------
cl_vals = [float(r["cl_max"]) for r in records]
cd_vals = [float(r["cd_cruise"]) for r in records]
ld_vals = [float(r["ld_ratio"]) for r in records]

cl_max_display = f"{round(max(cl_vals), 3):.3f}"                     # e.g. 0.545
cd_mean_display = f"{round(sum(cd_vals) / len(cd_vals), 4):.4f}"     # e.g. 0.0313
ld_mean_display = f"{round(sum(ld_vals) / len(ld_vals), 1):.1f}"     # e.g. 16.3
best_config = records[max(range(n), key=lambda i: ld_vals[i])]["config"]

# ---------- Build the document ----------
doc = Document()

# Title (Heading)
doc.add_heading("Engineering Test Report - Performance Data", 0)

# Overview
doc.add_heading("Overview", level=1)
doc.add_paragraph(
    f"This report summarizes the engineering performance test data. "
    f"The source file contains {n} data records (excluding the header row)."
)

# Results table
doc.add_heading("Results table", level=1)
table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=len(COLS))
table.style = "Table Grid"
for j, name in enumerate(COLS):
    table.rows[0].cells[j].text = name
for r in records:
    cells = table.add_row().cells
    for j, c in enumerate(COLS):
        cells[j].text = r[c]  # original strings -> same rounding as source

# Summary
doc.add_heading("Summary", level=1)
doc.add_paragraph(
    f"Key statistics computed from the {n} data records: "
    f"the maximum CLmax is {cl_max_display}; "
    f"the mean CDcruise is {cd_mean_display}; "
    f"the mean L/D ratio is {ld_mean_display}. "
    f"The best configuration, defined as the one achieving the maximum L/D ratio, "
    f"is {best_config}."
)

# Conclusion
doc.add_heading("Conclusion", level=1)
doc.add_paragraph(
    f"Across the {n} test records, configuration {best_config} achieved the highest "
    f"L/D ratio, and the dataset shows a mean L/D of {ld_mean_display} with a mean "
    f"CDcruise of {cd_mean_display}. All values reported here were computed directly "
    f"from the measured data, and {best_config} is identified as the leading candidate "
    f"for further evaluation."
)

doc.save(OUT_PATH)
print(f"Wrote {OUT_PATH} with {n} data rows; best config = {best_config}; "
      f"CLmax max = {cl_max_display}, CDcruise mean = {cd_mean_display}, "
      f"L/D mean = {ld_mean_display}")"
